verdict.rationale: Circle names x402 and documents concrete implementations: a seller integration that returns 402 Payment Required for unpaid requests, a public x402 Discovery API endpoint, Agent Nanopayments for paying x402 services in sub-cent USDC, and CLI support for paying for services. That goes well beyond a blog aspiration. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the x402 flows, a named x402-specific SDK or library, and any evidence for ACP, MPP or AP2.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform speaks the machine-payment protocols by name — x402, ACP, MPP, or AP2 support documented with endpoints or SDKs, not just a blog aspiration

citations.quote: Make your API charge AI agents per request in USDC over x402: your endpoint returns 402 Payment Required when a request is unpaid, and serves the resource when a valid payment is attached.
One public endpoint to discover x402 services that accept USDC, across many blockchains. No API key, no account.
Agent Nanopayments, built on Gateway Nanopayments, let your AI agent pay for x402-compatible services in sub-cent USDC.
Search x402-compatible APIs and pay per request, without subscriptions or API keys.
